description: This file defines classes and functions for text-based user interface components, including input/output handling, message windows, exception handling, and user interaction dialogs, for a Python application related to report management.

classes.name: IOHandler
classes.description: Provides methods for input and output, encapsulating input/output functions.

classes.name: TextWindow
classes.description: Provides common methods for text-based window UI components, such as printing headers and rules.

classes.name: TextIntf
classes.description: Implements an interface for text-based user interactions, including dialogs and exception windows.

classes.name: SaveExceptionWindow
classes.description: A window for handling save exceptions, runs report problem in memory.

classes.name: MainExceptionWindow
classes.description: Displays an error traceback and provides options for reporting, debugging, or quitting.

classes.name: MessageWindow
classes.description: Displays a message to the user and waits for acknowledgment.

classes.name: ExitWindow
classes.description: Confirms user exit with a prompt.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Prints a message using the output function.

methods.name: raw_input
methods.description: Gets user input with a prompt.

methods.name: enableNetwork
methods.description: Stub method to determine if network is enabled; returns False.

methods.name: mainExceptionWindow
methods.description: Creates and returns a main exception window.

methods.name: messageWindow
methods.description: Creates and runs a message window.

methods.name: saveExceptionWindow
methods.description: Creates and runs a save exception window.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the window's main loop, e.g., for exception or message windows.
